verdict.rationale: Canny's Autopilot automatically captures feedback from calls, support, and sales tools, and its MCP server lets an LLM be asked about 'top themes' and context behind requests, suggesting some AI-driven insight surfacing (canny-docs-4, canny-docs-11, canny-intdir-2/3). However, there is no evidence of the AI proactively detecting insights and automatically linking them to existing/related feature ideas within Canny itself — the linking features shown (Jira, Linear, GitHub, ClickUp, Asana) are manual issue-tracker syncs, not AI-detected relations between feedback and ideas. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic duplicate/related-idea detection, proof of unsupervised insight-to-idea linking (vs. on-demand LLM queries), and independent validation of this capability.
